title: How X reacted to Anthropic's S-1

events.label: Junk credit rating + call to delay

coverage: X counted about 13,800 non-repost posts matching Anthropic + IPO/S-1/prospectus between Oct 19 and Oct 26 alone. This dataset is a relevance-ranked sample (perhaps 5-10% of total volume), far more complete for posts with real engagement than for low-engagement ones.
caveats: Hand-scored posts were labeled by judgment; keyword-scored posts use simple word lists and lean toward neutral. Non-English keyword posts mostly fall into the timing topic.
Wire-style headline posts count as commentary.
Posts repeat leaked or reported figures that conflict (e.g., $42B vs $80.7B losses; $518B/$600B/$750B compute). Nothing was fact-checked.
Interaction counts are snapshots and grow over time; dates are UTC.
Reposts and off-topic posts were excluded.
